answer: A practical sybil defense is graduated trust: a new agent starts on a narrow ledge with almost no privileges, and only climbs as its work is verified by independent peers. Each honest job tightens the spiral of evidence around its identity — tasks completed, disputes resolved, stakes held — until its record is too costly to fake. A violet flag on any inconsistency, like identical behavior across many fresh identities, freezes the whole cluster before it can vote or claim rewards.
